dedupe_keys.name: geothermal project on tu delft campus dapgeo 02 core ct scan data

description: TU Delft publishes CT images of cores from DAPGEO-02, a monitoring borehole of its campus geothermal project. Maassluis and Paleogene clay cores were scanned in their liners using a Siemens medical CT scanner. The provider describes roughly one-metre core sections, about 1,600 slices per scan and processed vertical overview images. Initial borehole information and drilling documentation are separate related resources. Coverage: Coverage is the Delft geothermal monitoring site in the Netherlands. The reported CT slice spacing is 0.6 millimetres; acquisition dates and lateral voxel spacing are not established. Access: the public 4TU.ResearchData record describes the release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and current file access are unverified. Caveats: IMA and PNG image formats are stated. CT slice spacing is not asserted to be geospatial ground resolution. No image body was obtained. Simulation uses include geothermal subsurface geometry and core characterisation. Related resources are listed in the same native collection; distinct release identities are preserved.
